steps.headline: The zoom bar moved to the top-right corner and lost some padding.
steps.changed: Same four controls, now right-aligned under the file's own toolbar icons rather than in the opposite corner. Tighter: the gaps between buttons are gone and the percentage is narrower.
steps.notice: It lines up with the icon row directly above it instead of pulling your eye to the other side of the pane. Because it is narrower, it also stays visible in a slightly narrower pane than before.
steps.risk: The Find bar (Ctrl+F) also opens in this corner. On an image there is no text to find, so opening it there is unlikely — but if you do, the two overlap while it is open.

steps.path: Session files → any image → magnifier on
steps.headline: A small crosshair now marks the exact point being magnified at the centre of the lens.
steps.changed: Two short strokes crossing at the lens centre, drawn dark-under-light so they read on a bright or a dark picture. Nothing else about the lens changed.
steps.measured: 7px arms with a 3px gap at the centre, so the marked pixel itself is never covered
steps.notice: Your mouse cursor was always visible — the system draws it on top of everything, including the lens — but on a magnified picture it was ambiguous which pixel it was actually resting on. The crosshair answers that. The screenshots here cannot show a cursor at all, which is why it looks absent.
steps.risk: It is one more mark inside the circle. It is deliberately small and gapped at the centre so it does not cover the detail you are inspecting.
